description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating nested data structures, including getting, setting, and deleting paths within objects and arrays, with strict and non-strict variants.

methods.name: isArrayIndexSegment
methods.description: Checks if a string segment represents a valid array index (numeric).

methods.name: expectedContainer
methods.description: Determines whether the next segment indicates an array or object container.

methods.name: parseArrayLeafTarget
methods.description: Parses a cursor and leaf segment to identify if it targets an array element, returning the array and index.

methods.name: traverseToLeafParent
methods.description: Traverses the data structure to the parent of the target leaf, optionally requiring existing segments.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specified path within a nested data structure.

methods.name: setPathCreateStrict
methods.description: Sets a value at a specified path, creating intermediate objects or arrays as needed, strictly.

methods.name: setPathExistingStrict
methods.description: Sets a value at a specified path only if the path exists, strictly.

methods.name: deletePathStrict
methods.description: Deletes a value at a specified path, strictly.
